title: Idea
description: The founder's startup idea text split into problem, solution, and target user components.

text.description: Full raw idea text as submitted by the founder.

target_user.description: Extracted target user: the specific person or organization who has the problem and who the product is for. Absent in runs created before v3.0.0.

codename.description: Optional short codename for the idea (e.g. 'Airlock'). Shown in the report topbar and doc header.

icon.description: Optional single emoji used as the doc icon in the report. Defaults to 📋 when absent.

subtitle.description: Optional one-sentence framing shown under the doc title. Falls back to the first sentence of text when absent.
